title: Strong-CP cancellation and baryon stability from complete Fold support
description:
Read the full paper (PDF)

Complete colour-times-hand support uniquely fixes strong-sector alignment, while every finite composition of all 83 generated mediator signatures preserves its prime fibre.

Maria Smith derives aligned One for paired strong hands and the unique self-antipodal half-One for an independent one-hand restriction. Strong-CP violation, electric-dipole and additional-compensator carriers are empty-One records. The complete inventory has 202 ordered cross-fibre label pairs and no generated cross-fibre action; all 27 colour-three proton images retain baryon tally One.

A separate executed matter–antimatter process retains a positive baryon residue exactly when tally change, conjugate-path distinction and reverse-completion hold coexist. The paper derives all eight cases and explains the precise relation between this cosmological process and the closed mediator grammar.

The neutron electric-dipole comparison retains its upper limit, statistical and systematic uncertainties and 90 percent confidence. All six proton-decay modes are listed individually with finite lifetime limits, confidence levels, candidate records and interpretations. Complete source-bound observations and both adverse controls are included.

Full mathematics, intermediate derivations, exhaustive 1,024-, 2,048- and 256-form grammars and native Lean 4 proof references appear in the paper. The accompanying archive contains pinned V3/V4 sources, full program and observation comparisons, build and empty-axiom audit evidence, and portable exact-arithmetic reproduction.
